name: ATICA Lax Processing
definition: Specifies a data structure that allows to include any valid XML Structure (tha is through an XML Schema). The property namespace is set to 'any'.|The processContents value is 'lax' which means that if the item has a uniquely determined declaration available, it must be ·valid· with respect to that definition, that is, ·validate· if you can, don't worry if you can't, that is it MAY be validated or not.
